req_spec.title: UC-S3-011/012/013/019/020 Chat with AI Assistant
req_spec.scope: Student chats with the AI tutor, keeps a conversation history, continues and deletes conversations. Source: UniShare_Iteration_3.md AI Learning Assistant Use Case, Sequence 2, Use Case 2 (UC-S3-012); src/app/(student)/ai/[[...id]]/page.tsx, src/components/ai/ai-chat-interface.tsx, conversation-history-sidebar.tsx, src/app/api/chat/route.ts, src/server/api/routers/ai.ts.

requirement.title: Only approved, logged-in students use the AI assistant
requirement.description: The /ai page shall be available only to authenticated users with role APPROVED; a PENDING user is redirected to /waiting-approval. POST /api/chat without a session returns 401 'Unauthorized'.

requirement.title: Message validation
requirement.description: A message shall not be empty (whitespace only counts as empty; the Send button stays disabled and nothing is sent) and shall be at most 5000 characters ('Message must be under 5000 characters', Iteration 3 A2). Implementation note: tRPC ai.sendMessage accepts 1-10000 characters.

requirement.title: New conversation is created on first message
requirement.description: Sending the first message in a new chat creates an AiConversation owned by the user with the client-generated id, temperature 0-2 (default 0.7) and an AI-generated title of at most 6 words (fallback: first 50 characters of the message). The URL changes to /ai/<id> and the conversation appears at the top of the sidebar. A request without conversationId returns 400 'No conversation ID provided'.

requirement.title: Streaming response and persistence
requirement.description: The AI answer (model badge 'Gemini 2.5 Flash') streams into the chat while a loader is shown; input submission is disabled while status is submitted/streaming. When the stream finishes the user and assistant messages are saved (assistant message with tokensUsed) and the conversation updatedAt is set.

requirement.title: Continue a previous conversation
requirement.description: Opening /ai/<id> loads all messages of that conversation oldest first; a follow-up message is answered with the earlier messages as context and is appended to the same conversation.

requirement.title: Conversation history sidebar
requirement.description: The sidebar lists only the user's conversations, most recently updated first, 5 at a time; 'Load More' adds 10 more and the footer shows 'Showing <n> of <total>'. A conversation without title shows 'Untitled Chat'. 'New Chat' opens an empty chat at /ai. API page size 1-100.

requirement.title: Delete a conversation
requirement.description: The delete icon asks 'Delete this conversation? This action cannot be undone.'; on OK the conversation and all its messages are deleted (cascade) and it disappears from the sidebar; on Cancel nothing changes.

requirement.title: Conversation privacy
requirement.description: A user can read, continue or delete only his own conversations. Another user's conversation id gives NOT_FOUND 'Conversation not found' (Iteration 3 A3: no access to other users' conversations).

requirement.title: AI unavailable handling
requirement.description: If the AI server cannot be reached the chat shows 'Unable to connect to AI server. Please make sure Ollama is running.'; a server-side failure returns 500 'Failed to process AI request'. The user message is kept and the student can retry.

req_spec.title: UC-S3-014/015 Generate and Attempt AI Quiz
req_spec.scope: Student generates a practice quiz with AI for a course and attempts it with automatic grading. Source: UniShare_Iteration_3.md Sequence 3, Use Case 3 (UC-S3-014), UC-S3-015; src/server/api/routers/ai.ts (generateQuiz, getQuizzes, getQuiz, submitQuizAttempt, deleteQuiz); src/server/ai/quiz-generator.ts; src/components/ai/quiz-generator-form.tsx, quiz-taker.tsx, quiz-results.tsx, quiz-list.tsx; course page tab 'Quizzes'.

requirement.title: Quiz generation form and limits
requirement.description: Course > Quizzes > Generate Quiz shows Topic * (required, trimmed; empty gives 'Please enter a topic'), Number of Questions slider 5-50 in steps of 5 (default 10), Difficulty Easy/Medium/Hard (default Medium) and Question Types Multiple Choice, True/False (checked by default) and Short Answer. The API accepts questionCount 1-50 and difficulty easy|medium|hard.

requirement.title: At least one question type
requirement.description: Submitting with no question type checked shows 'Please select at least one question type' and no quiz is generated.

requirement.title: Course / note context access
requirement.description: A quiz may be generated for a course or note only by the course owner or an ACCEPTED collaborator. Unknown course: 'Course not found'; no access: 'You don't have access to this course'. Unknown note: 'Note not found'; no access: 'You don't have access to this note'.

requirement.title: Successful generation is saved
requirement.description: On success the quiz and its questions (in generated order) are stored for the user with the topic as prompt and token usage, toast 'Quiz generated successfully!' is shown and the quiz opens for taking. While generating, the form is disabled and the button shows 'Generating...'. If the AI answer is not valid quiz JSON the error 'Failed to generate quiz. The AI response was not in the expected format.' is shown and nothing is saved.

requirement.title: Taking a quiz
requirement.description: The quiz taker shows '<answered> of <total> answered', '<p>% complete', one button per question, Previous (disabled on question 1), Next, and on the last question 'Submit Quiz', which stays disabled until every question is answered ('Please answer all questions before submitting'). Multiple choice shows the generated options, True/False shows True and False, Short Answer shows 'Type your answer here...'.

requirement.title: Automatic grading and score
requirement.description: Multiple choice and True/False answers are correct only on exact match with the stored correct answer; Short Answer is compared trimmed and case-insensitive. Score = correct / total questions x 100. The attempt is saved with completedAt. Results show the score with message: >=90 'Excellent!', >=80 'Great job!', >=70 'Good work!', >=60 'Not bad!', otherwise 'Keep studying!'.

requirement.title: Quiz list and repeated attempts
requirement.description: The Quizzes tab lists the user's quizzes for the course newest first with 'Best Score: <n>%'; with none it shows 'No quizzes yet'. A quiz can be attempted any number of times ('Retake Quiz'); every attempt is kept.

requirement.title: Quiz ownership and delete
requirement.description: Only the creator can open, attempt or delete a quiz; otherwise 'Quiz not found'. Delete asks 'Are you sure you want to delete this quiz? This action cannot be undone.' and removes the quiz with its questions and attempts.

req_spec.title: UC-S3-016/017 Generate and Track AI Study Plan
req_spec.scope: Student generates a weekly study plan for a course and tracks task completion. Source: UniShare_Iteration_3.md Sequence 4, UC-S3-016, UC-S3-017, Data Description 'Study Plan Generation'; src/server/api/routers/ai.ts (generateStudyPlan, getStudyPlans, updateStudyPlanTask, deleteStudyPlan); src/server/ai/study-plan-generator.ts; src/components/ai/study-plan-generator-form.tsx, study-plan-viewer.tsx, study-plan-list.tsx; prisma/schema.prisma (AiStudyPlan).

requirement.title: Study plan form and limits
requirement.description: Generate Study Plan requires a course ('Please select a course'); Number of Weeks 1-16 (default 4; Iteration 3 states 1-12), Hours Per Week 1-40 (default 5), Learning Goal (Optional) and Target Deadline (Optional, dates before today cannot be picked). Values outside the ranges are rejected by the API.

requirement.title: Course access for study plans
requirement.description: Only the course owner or an ACCEPTED collaborator can generate a plan for a course. Unknown course: 'Course not found'; no access: 'You don't have access to this course'.

requirement.title: Generated plan is saved with weeks and tasks
requirement.description: On success the plan is saved with its weeks (ordered by week number) and tasks (in order), toast 'Study plan generated successfully!' is shown. Without goal the stored prompt is 'Study plan for course'. With a deadline endDate = deadline and startDate = deadline - weeks x 7 days. Invalid AI JSON gives 'Failed to generate study plan. The AI response was not in the expected format.'

requirement.title: Track progress
requirement.description: Ticking a task marks it completed (completedAt set, toast 'Task updated'); unticking clears completedAt. Overall Progress = completed tasks / all tasks x 100 (rounded, 0% when there are no tasks) and every week shows its Week Progress; a week at 100% is shown as complete.

requirement.title: Plan ownership and delete
requirement.description: Only the owner of a plan can update its tasks ('Task not found' otherwise) or delete it ('Study plan not found'). Delete asks 'Are you sure you want to delete this study plan? This action cannot be undone.'. With no plans the tab shows 'No study plans yet'.

requirement.title: Plan kept when the course is deleted
requirement.description: Study plans are linked to a course by an optional courseId with SET NULL on course delete, so plans are preserved (Iteration 3 Data Description).

req_spec.title: UC-S3-018 Enhance Notes with AI
req_spec.scope: Student uses AI to generate, improve, summarize or expand a course note. Source: UniShare_Iteration_3.md UC-S3-018, Data Description 'Note Enhancement'; src/app/api/ai/generate-note/route.ts; src/server/api/routers/ai.ts (generateNote, getNoteGenerations).

requirement.title: Enhancement request validation
requirement.description: Type must be one of GENERATE, IMPROVE, SUMMARIZE, EXPAND and prompt must be 1-5000 characters; otherwise 400 'Invalid request'. Temperature, if given, 0-2.

requirement.title: Only owner or contributor can enhance a note
requirement.description: The course owner and ACCEPTED CONTRIBUTORs can enhance a note. A VIEWER or unrelated user gets 403 'Forbidden: You don't have permission to edit this note'; unknown note 404 'Note not found'; no session 401 'Unauthorized'.

requirement.title: Enhancement result and history
requirement.description: A successful call returns success, generatedText (markdown) and tokensUsed and stores an AiGeneratedNote with prompt, type, content before and after. getNoteGenerations returns only the caller's generations for that note, newest first (page size 1-50, default 20). AI provider errors return 503.

req_spec.title: UC-S4-002 Real-Time Collaborative Notes
req_spec.scope: Course owner and collaborators edit nested note pages together in real time (Liveblocks + BlockNote). Source: UniShare_Iteration_4.md Use Case Diagram 2 and Use Case 2 (UC-S4-002), Data Description 'Note Table'; src/app/(student)/courses/[id]/notes/[[...pageId]]/page.tsx, src/components/notes/*, src/components/resources/resource-card.tsx, src/app/api/notes/create, src/app/api/notes/[id], src/app/api/liveblocks-auth/route.ts.

requirement.title: Open course notes
requirement.description: 'Open Collaborative Notes' on the Notes card opens /courses/<id>/notes. If the course has no pages and the user can edit, a page 'Getting Started' is created and opened; a VIEWER sees 'No pages have been created yet. Ask a contributor or owner to create one.'. Without page id, or with an unknown / other course page id, the first page is opened.

requirement.title: Only course members can open notes
requirement.description: Only the owner and ACCEPTED collaborators can open the notes: others are redirected to /courses/<id>, logged-out users to /login, unknown course to /courses. Liveblocks auth: no session 401 'Unauthorized', missing room 400 'Bad Request - Room ID missing', unknown page 404 'Page not found', non-member 403 'Forbidden'.

requirement.title: Role-based editing (OWNER / CONTRIBUTOR / VIEWER)
requirement.description: The header shows the role badge OWNER, CONTRIBUTOR or VIEWER. OWNER and CONTRIBUTOR can edit content, titles and pages. VIEWER sees 'Viewing in Read-Only Mode', cannot type in the editor or title and sees no add/delete page controls; the server must not accept a VIEWER's edits (Iteration 4: VIEWER read-only).

requirement.title: Real-time synchronisation and persistence
requirement.description: Text typed by one member appears for the other members of the same page in real time; concurrent edits, also of the same block, merge without conflict and all editors converge (Yjs CRDT). Content is persisted by Liveblocks ('All changes saved') and is still there after reload.

requirement.title: Presence of live collaborators
requirement.description: The 'Active Collaborators' bar shows the current user ('<name> (You)') and up to 5 other online users as coloured initials, '+<n>' for more, and '<count> online'. When a user leaves, his avatar disappears.

requirement.title: Create pages and nested sub-pages
requirement.description: The '+' button in 'Pages' creates an 'Untitled' page placed after the last page and opens it; 'Add sub-page' creates a child page shown indented under its parent (expand/collapse). Each page has its own room. The title is edited inline and saved on Enter or leaving the field.

requirement.title: Delete pages and server-side permission checks
requirement.description: Delete asks 'Are you sure you want to delete this page?'; deleting a page also deletes its sub-pages; if the open page is deleted the first remaining page opens. A VIEWER calling the API gets 403 'You don't have permission to create pages' / 'You don't have permission to edit this page' / 'You don't have permission to delete this page'.

requirement.title: Network interruption
requirement.description: If a member loses connection, edits are kept locally and synchronised when the connection returns (Iteration 4 UC-S4-002 A1).
